# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.2

## Changed

- **Mood card:** the seven-day strip is gone. Tap a mood and it still asks why.
- **Daily review card:** review only (Focus has its own card), no sideways paging, medium / large / full-row sizes, dictation, and an expand button that opens a larger editor.
- **Week:** weekly review and weekly goals sit side by side at the top.
- **Sidebar quote** is light text on the dark sidebar in both themes.
- **Pointer feedback everywhere:** the Today calendar, the Today header card and the Habits summary cards lift like every other card; filters and view switches show a hover state.
- Year, month and language pickers look the same in Safari and Chrome.

## Added

- **Settings → Quotes:** automatic, or your own list (one stays, several rotate daily).
- **Settings → Page order** for Today, Week, Horizon, Timeline and Review.
- **Default weather city** until you pick one: Berlin (German), London (UK English), Beijing (Chinese).

## Fixed

- **Your name and photo are editable again.** Click your name in the sidebar. The editor was lost in a rollback on 18 October; name and photo stay on this device and never change your sign-in or synced records.

## Unchanged

- Cloud edition data, sync, photos and Google Calendar; no migration.

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.1` stays available. See [2.0.0 → Roll back to 1.3](v2.0.0.md#roll-back-to-13) for older versions.
